text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her day off, Winning Ticket storms into my office with immense fervor.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Right? I know! Yesterday I ate lots and slept even more!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So now I'm totally powered up—FULL BLAST! Like, I'm in super-duper top condition!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on, time to start already! I can do a million laps! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ticket is brimming with power and spirit after thoroughly enjoying her day off.
